```yaml
name: Validate OpenAPI Specs

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'openapi*.yml'
      - 'envd.yaml'

jobs:
  validate-openapi:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        spec:
          - openapi.yml
          - openapi-edge.yml
          - openapi-hyperloop.yml
          - envd.yaml

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install -g @redocly/cli

      - name: Validate OpenAPI spec
        run: redocly lint ${{ matrix.spec }} --config .redocly.yaml
        id: validate

      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: true
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Fail if validation fails
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        run: echo "OpenAPI spec validation failed" && exit 1
```
